events.event_name: NEST New York Cardamom Latte Café
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, W 14th St & 9th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW fragrance café for NEST New York's Cardamom Latte Eau de Parfum, pairing fragrance discovery with complimentary Cardamom Lattes.
events.what_is_free: Public admission and a complimentary Cardamom Latte are advertised, with lattes and sampling available while supplies last.
events.caveats: Fashionista and NYC for FREE both list September 14 from 10 AM–9 PM, with complimentary lattes while supplies last. Average Socialite lists a 5 PM end time, so the stronger two-source agreement is used but visitors should expect the activation to end early if supplies run out.
events.practical_notes: Walk-in public activation at Chelsea Triangle. No RSVP or organizer-approval requirement is published in the verified sources.

events.address: The Bowery Hotel, 335 Bowery, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW beauty pop-up at The Bowery Hotel with personalized hair touch-ups, custom cocktails and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Public access is offered by RSVP; Fashionista describes the event as open to the public and links directly to the live RSVPify registration page.
events.caveats: A working RSVPify registration page is live. No host-approval language was found in the verified public sources, so this is classified as Free RSVP rather than Approval Required. Event capacity may still apply.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 from 5–8 PM at The Bowery Hotel. Use the direct RSVPify page to register before traveling.

occurrences.details: Complimentary lattes and fragrance sampling while supplies last.
Free RSVP required; no organizer-approval requirement found in verified public sources.
